classCard.name: Metaspell Access
classCard.rangeAndTarget: One Mage spell you are beginning to cast
classCard.frequency: 1/long rest; choose one metamagic mode when this feature is acquired
classCard.effect: Metaspell Access. Tags: arcanist, metamagic. Choose one mode permanently: Reach increases one spell's range by 30 feet; Widen increases one circular radius or cone length by 5 feet; Sculpt lets up to M creatures automatically succeed on that spell's initial area save and take no damage if success normally halves damage. Apply the chosen mode once per long rest before casting; it does not alter RP cost or create another cast.
